title: Most news feeds are broken because they treat everyone exactly the same.
body:
We are drowning in information, yet we often feel like we are missing the stories that actually matter to our lives. The problem isn't a lack of news. The problem is that most algorithms are designed to keep you scrolling, not to keep you informed. They prioritize outrage and viral trends over substance.

Personalization shouldn't mean being trapped in a filter bubble. True personalization is about relevance. It means getting the facts you need on the topics you care about, without the noise. It is about respecting your time by delivering high-quality journalism that fits into your day, rather than demanding your entire attention.

We built Headlinne to change this dynamic. We use AI to cut through the clutter and surface the stories that actually impact your interests and your world. It is a tool to help you stay smart, not just entertained.
cta: See how we are rethinking the way you get your news at HEADLINNE.com.
